subject: english
stem: At first, Amy would not speak during group work. After her partner invited one short comment each day, Amy volunteered to present their final idea. How does Amy change?
options: She becomes more willing to speak publicly.
She becomes unable to work with others.
She decides never to speak again.

optionRationales.reason: She becomes more willing to speak publicly.：從拒絕發言到主動報告，態度能力同向改變。
She becomes unable to work with others.：與合作相反。
She decides never to speak again.：與 volunteered 相反。
Only her partner changes.：Amy 的行動明顯改變。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「故事開頭與結尾在能力、態度、信念或行動上的對照顯示人物變化」可推出 She becomes more willing to speak publicly.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 She becomes more willing to speak publicly. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
